findings.first_frame: 1.6s is a near-black frame with one thin vertical sliver of light and a faint back silhouette; the 'closed door in a dark room' reads, but only just. 1.6-2.2 stays this dark (0.6s), then the doors move. Accepted because the slit is the beat and the previous shot will carry context; do not start earlier than 1.6.
findings.motion: 1.6-2.2 slit widens slowly, 2.2-3.0 both shutter doors swing open and the doorway blows out to near-white, 3.0-4.3 figure settles with arms extending to the door edges. Continuous movement through the full 2.7s.
findings.faces: Back of head only across the entire used range and through 4.6s; face never turns.
findings.acting: Natural door push and hold; no camera acknowledgement. The 'take in the view' arms-out pose from ~3.6s is slightly hotel-ad, but it is a silhouette and reads as a pause, not a performance.
findings.tone: Desaturated dark interior, warm-grey natural light, filmic. Weakness 1: the blowout is confined to the doorway (roughly a quarter of the frame width), so the frame never truly goes white; the rest stays black. Weakness 2: from ~3.2s a sea horizon, balcony rail and a palm frond become readable, so the location says tropical hotel balcony rather than street. Weakness 3: the subject is in a crop top and underwear; legs/hips start to read as the light hits her from ~4.0s. Hard out at 4.3s; never extend to 4.4+.
findings.framing: Third-person back view from inside the room, 16:9, subject centered. Recommend a center push-in of ~1.3-1.5x on the doorway (which also crops the balcony floor/legs) plus a 1-2% exposure lift or highlight bloom over 3.4-4.3s to push the white-out and soften the sea/palm read.

alternates_verdict.21812: Rejected: static white door for the first 1.8s (no motion), door opens onto a bedroom with no light bloom, and a saturated yellow/blue dress fills the gap from 2.4s. 720p. Fails the motion and color rules.
alternates_verdict.27591: Rejected: camera is outside the house, woman's face is frontal and clearly visible 2.9-4.5s, flat grey light with no bloom. Fails the no-face rule.
